quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
Scattered Pages
quest.text: Ensio and the other helpers are trying to recreate the destroyed books from the pages the slimes left behind. Bring him any Book Pages you get from the Blue and White Slimes. So far he has only a handful of the missing pages.
Ensio can be found at (104,86) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
Scattered Pages
quest.text: Thanks to the Book Pages you brought, Ensio has recovered some of the missing pages, but many are still missing. The Blue and White Slimes carry more of them.
Ensio can be found at (104,86) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
Scattered Pages
quest.text: Ensio has already sorted quite a lot of the missing pages. Keep bringing him the Book Pages you get from the Blue and White Slimes.
Ensio can be found at (104,86) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
Scattered Pages
quest.text: Only a few pages are still missing. Keep bringing Book Pages to Ensio until he has found them all.
Ensio can be found at (104,86) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
Every Page Accounted For
quest.text: You found every page the helpers were missing! Once they also have all the material to repair the books, Nikolai will want to reward you.
Nikolai can be found at (98,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Pages
A Library Reborn
quest.text: Nikolai gave you a Grimoire as thanks for your help with recovering the books of the library.

quest.name: Blue Sage Materials
Paper, Glue, Ink and Covers
quest.text: The helpers of the Blue Sage need material to repair the books and to create new ones. Kullervo needs 20 Reed Bundles for paper, Santeri 8 Yeti Claws for glue, Janika 80 Silk Cocoons for the covers, and Eevert 5 Bottles of Water, 4 Iron Powder, 3 Wisp Powder, 3 Spectre Powder and 3 Poltergeist Powder for ink. Some of them still lack what they need.
The helpers can be found in the workshop and the library of the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Materials
Paper, Glue, Ink and Covers
quest.text: You brought the helpers all the material they need to repair the books. Nikolai rewards this together with the recovery of the missing pages.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
Between the Bookshelves
quest.text: Pyry told you about the slimes breeding in the deeper parts of the library and gladly accepted your offer to fight them. Every slime of a nest has to die before the nest is extinguished: the White Slimes come in groups, and the Blue Slimes protect themselves with smaller slimes.
Pyry can be found at (117,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
Between the Bookshelves
quest.text: You extinguished some of the slime nests between the bookshelves, but most of them are still there. Pyry can tell you roughly how many are left.
Pyry can be found at (117,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
Between the Bookshelves
quest.text: You extinguished more than half of the slime nests between the bookshelves. Pyry can tell you roughly how many are left.
Pyry can be found at (117,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
Between the Bookshelves
quest.text: Only one slime nest is left somewhere between the bookshelves in the deeper parts of the library.
Pyry can be found at (117,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
A Clean Sweep
quest.text: You extinguished every slime nest in the library! Nikolai will surely want to thank you for that.
Nikolai can be found at (98,106) within the Blue Sages' Mansion.

quest.name: Blue Sage Slimes
A Clean Sweep
quest.text: Nikolai gave you an Ice Gladius for wiping out the slimes in the library.
